title: agent.register payload v1
description: Sent by an Agent immediately after establishing its outbound WebSocket connection, so the Control Plane can identify the server and its capabilities.

server_id.description: Stable id assigned to this server when it was registered in the dashboard.

enrollment_token.description: Per-server secret proving this agent is authorized to represent server_id.

adapters.description: V1 adapters this agent can run on this host.
